# vMLX 1.6.63

## Changes

- Bonsai 2 27B JANG now keeps language activations and attention KV in FP16, avoiding unintended promotion by FP32 norm/convolution weights. Hadamard accumulation, checkpoint parameters and native recurrent state keep their required precision; the vision tower is unchanged.
- Prefix and SSD cache identity now includes the activation precision policy. Earlier FP32 states cannot be restored into the changed execution path. Existing model bundles and cache files are not rewritten.
- Both Ternary and packed 1.75-bit storage are supported. Packed 1.75-bit weights still expand losslessly to native 2-bit weights in memory; this is not a 1.75-bit RAM claim.
- No dependency versions, saved session choices, tool/reasoning contracts, audio capabilities or MTP support change. Performance is workload-dependent. Unqualified kernel experiments are not enabled.
